limits: Source path audit only; physical clock nets must be checked after implementation.

Public PCS reset uses the existing reset synchronizer interface. F402 also adds a timer load to the existing raw MMCM-lock reset path; this is not a claim that every new reset endpoint is independently synchronized.
PMA-reset deassertion is synchronized by the existing four-stage helper. The reused common RstDelayTimer itself uses asynchronous rstIn; it has no internal deassertion synchronizer.
This V2 clarifies reset endpoint scope in the first static audit, without changing HDL or measurements.
No claim to validate analog PLL/CDR behavior or external TDC performance.
